page_note: Page 92 is almost pure cosmological substrate: a sustained narrative of the Ambassador (Third Messenger) constructing the cosmic apparatus — choosing the five noetic ones from the Rising, setting in their midst Calling and Hearing, then the Great Mind / Pillar of Glory / Perfect Man, then Jesus the Youth as icon of Proclamation and Hearing; establishing the encampments above and below with each cosmic agent in his watch-station (ⲙⲁⲛⲣⲁⲓⲥ); the Pherokatochos standing fast in the third firmament; the descent of Sin who mingles with the light and peers against the icon of the Ambassador; the molding of trees on dry land and torpor in the sea; the Great King of Honor in the third firmament; and the descent of the Egregoroi (Watchers) who disclose mysteries of heaven to humans. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system — cosmic agent → station → action → effect. The "ⲧⲧⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲁⲛ" connectives here are NOT dialogue frame; they are narrative-cosmological "once again" linking sequential cosmic acts of the Ambassador. The single ecclesial vocabulary hit (ⲙⲩⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ at i=29) is the Watchers-myth motif of celestial mysteries disclosed to humanity — substratic, not institutional. The fatigue-drift score is an artifact of heavy lacunae in the lower half (55.9% damage), not editorial overlay. Damage is significant but the surviving text is uniformly substrate.
